sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicant no. 1 and the opposite party no. 2 are husband and wife respectively.
There was matrimonial discord between them due to which the instant FIR has been lodged by the opposite party no. 2 against the applicants herein.
However, during the pendency of the said case parties have settled their dispute and a compromise has been executed between them on 2.78.2025, which was placed before the trial court.
Certified copy of the same has been annexed as Annexure-6 to the instant application.
Vide order dated 21.8.2025, this court had directed the parties to appear before the trial court concerned for verification of the compromise entered between them.

In terms of the order of this court the parties have appeared before the trial court on 9.9.2025 and in the presence of the parties the trial court has verified the compromise arrived at between them.
Learned counsel for the applicants further submits that in terms of the compromise agreed between the parties the entire amount has been paid to the opposite party no. 2 by the applicants.
The parties have also filed application under 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, which is stated to be still pending.
Thus learned counsel for the applicants seeks quashing of the entire proceedings of the instant case.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the aforesaid facts and admits the compromise entered into between the parties and its verification by the trial court.

5. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case learned for the State also does not oppose the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of the instant case.
6. In view of the facts and circumstances, since it was a matrimonial dispute between the applicant no.1 and the opposite party no.2, which has been amicably settled between the parties therefore no fruitful purpose will be served by keeping the criminal proceeding pending against the applicants herein and due to the aforesaid compromise, there are very remote and bleak chances of the conviction of the applicants.
Further, with the aforesaid settlement of matrimonial dispute, peace will prevail not only in the families of the parties but in society at large.

sentences.text:
Thus, in the light of the judgments of the Apex Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab and Another : (2012) 10 SCC 303; Prabatbhai Aahir Alias Prabatbhai Bhimsinghbhai Karmur and others vs. State of Gujarat and Another : (2017) 9 SCC 641; Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab :
(2014) 6 SCC 466 and B.S.Joshi and Other vs. State of Haryana and Another : (2003) 4 SCC 67, the instant application is allowed and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 28489 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No 11 of 2020 (State Vs. Saurabh and others) under sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act police station Hastinapur District Meerut, charge sheet dated 15.11.2022 and cognizance order dated 19.12.20222 passed by Judicial Magistrate III, First Class Meerut are hereby quashed.
